lines.en: Yesterday's post left out the comments.
It was the day's biggest change.

lines.ko: AI가 작업 기록인 커밋을 읽고 글을 씁니다.

lines.en: But it only read the latest 20 commits.
Of 121 commits that day, 101 were left out.

lines.ko: 이제 그날 커밋을 끝까지 다 읽습니다.
lines.en: Now it reads every commit of the day.
lines.art: a small robot reading a very long unrolled scroll all the way to its last end

lines.en: Posts already up can now be rewritten too.
I'll bring the comments story back.
